per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material remains a separate complete-with-gaps layer; XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database surfaces were obtainable locally and sufficient for worker-4/6 source review.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Final artifacts satisfy required schema/provenance fields and are not promoted merely from packet presence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Eleven APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP identity records were adjudicated against primary sequence/modification/source evidence; six modified-sequence rows remain sequence_modified_not_normalized by design.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/DRAMP oxidized methionine entries use modified sequence notation and are retained as modification-specific records rather than normalized into unmodified parent turgencins.
DRAMP literature rows are PMID-linked and omit PMCID in the packet literature snapshot; canonical DOI/PMID are preserved and source identity remains supported by local paper material.
Table 1 peptide labels preserve reported oxidation-state mixture percentages; final activity rows must not be collapsed into plain parent peptide names.

Direct mechanism evidence supports rapid B. subtilis membrane-integrity/viability perturbation for AMox1/B and negative/weak E. coli short-window evidence; molecular target and pore architecture are not claimed.

The material packet remains complete-with-gaps because structured supplementary tables were not parsed from PDF, but the local supplementary text/PDF and primary XML were sufficient for worker-4/6 adjudication.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/worker-6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 after reopening the local XML, PDF, OA package, supplementary PDF/text, locator index, packet database snapshots, and merged database rows. The paper is publication-grade with cautions: modified turgencin oxiform records remain explicit, database cross-reference caveats are preserved, and mechanism claims are bounded to the assays actually present locally.
